bounded_scope: One independent pass over both finalized files, source workbook values and headers, primary JCI methods/caption, patent Figure 4 drawing and text legend, and official 2024 conference abstract. No broad research expansion or editing of the reviewed artifacts.

checks.question: Are 26 numeric entries correctly counted without becoming 26 verified independent animals?
checks.independent_verification: Read XLSX values directly by resolving workbook relationships and shared strings. All five exact cell ranges and every value match. Recomputed group means, medians and ranges match.
checks.interpretation: The files keep animal identity and cross-endpoint pairing unresolved; no new cohort or independent dataset is invented.

checks.question: Are regimen and timing ambiguities preserved?
checks.independent_verification: Fig 6A headers are 25/50/100; Fig S6B headers are D22/D25. Fig S6A C2 contains the BIDx5 and QDx3 P22 regimen. JCI describes terminal collection and the pilot twice-daily narrative.
checks.source_cell_exact_text: KO Day 22 - BLU797 75 mpk, BIDx5 and QDx3
checks.source_cell_text_normalization: Nonbreaking spaces normalized to spaces; source BLU797 spelling preserved here.
checks.interpretation: The source wording is not silently reconciled. Elapsed sample hours, trough status, AUC and half-life remain unassigned.

checks.question: Does engineered HEK evidence remain distinct from native cellular access and exact47 activity?
checks.independent_verification: Visually inspected original-PDF Figure 4B image: GFP-PI3KC2beta HEK context, full medium, 1 micromolar, overnight then two-hour PKN1/2 co-treatment, pS6K/total-S6K endpoint. Drawing names DC-03-036/040/090/096.
checks.interpretation: The files do not assign these results to exact47, exact91, BLU NanoBRET host/construct, native muscle, fractional occupancy or intracellular unbound exposure. First/second blot labels are not converted to independent biological N.

checks.question: Is the numerical example mapping correctly treated as a checked non-error?
checks.independent_verification: Patent Figure 4 text legend explicitly names examples 36, 40, 90 and 96; it agrees with drawing labels. Figure 5 and the text place examples47/91 in HEK293 lysate profiling.
checks.interpretation: No unsupported historical correction and no live-cell transfer from other examples or lysate affinity.

checks.question: Are the conference panel and article-identity limits accurately represented?
checks.independent_verification: Official 2024 abstract printed p23/physical p24 reports three lead compounds and a117-kinase panel excluding C2gamma. It supplies no compound numbers/structures, full numerical panel or exposure package. Authors Cirillo, Lo, Haucke and Nazare overlap the patent inventors.
checks.interpretation: C2gamma omission is not sparing; unspecified leads do not fill exact47/91/BLU fields, create qualified assets or establish independent replication.

checks.question: Does the exposure conclusion respect what is and is not identifiable?
checks.independent_verification: Both files separate biochemical potency, engineered cellular readout, reported plasma concentrations, and unmeasured native target-site exposure.
checks.interpretation: They neither claim inadequate exposure nor invent an unbound human-muscle therapeutic window. Not-located ADME/metabolite information is scoped to the inspected sources. The score and qualification status are unchanged.

checks.question: Are new contributions separated from repeated evidence?
checks.independent_verification: New assay-context metadata and the new program-level abstract are distinguished from recounted workbook observations and carried-forward comparator panels.
checks.interpretation: No cumulative inflation of observations, candidates or qualified compounds.

sources.reading_method: ZIP/XML text and numeric values; no editing or recalculation of workbook formulas.

limitations: This pass does not establish unique animal identity, sampling times or a clinical exposure margin.
Historical exact47/exact91 single-point numeric panels were reviewed for handling and consistency but were not re-extracted from every original table cell in this bounded review.
This is not an independent experimental replication, a complete ADME search, or an IP/FTO review.
